title: Toxic Spore Cloud
description: A thick cloud of yellow-green spores drifts through the passage, released by a cluster of puffball fungi growing from the walls. The air tastes metallic and your eyes water at its edge. Beyond the cloud you can see scattered belongings from someone who didn't make it through.

choices.label: Hold breath and dash through
choices.description: Rush past the spore cloud to grab whatever was left behind.

outcomes.text: You burst through the cloud in one breath and snatch the coin pouch from the ground. Not bad for ten seconds of terror.
You make it through, but the explorer's pack holds more than coin -- dried spore samples and a bundle of mycelium thread.
Halfway through, you gasp involuntarily. The spores burn like fire in your lungs. You grab the pouch and stumble clear, retching.

choices.label: Harvest the puffballs
choices.description: Carefully cut the puffball fungi from the walls. Their threads are useful.

outcomes.text: You approach from upwind and slice the puffballs free. The mycelium threads inside are thick and strong -- good material.
The puffballs yield fine thread, and buried in the wall behind them you spot a cluster of mature spores.
Your blade nicks a swollen cap and it bursts point-blank. You reel back, eyes streaming, barely saving the threads you cut.

choices.label: Retreat
choices.description: Back away before the spores reach you.

outcomes.text: You pull your collar over your nose and back away. The cloud drifts past, indifferent to your retreat.
